overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation. A two-member phone call was not a quorum, and the other members attested to no outside communications about the Commission. The AG also reminded the Board of its response deadlines and its duty to cooperate with investigations.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board deliberated about Conservation Commission appointments outside a noticed meeting, including a chair-member phone call before a June 2013 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: There is no evidence that a quorum of the Board members communicated outside of a noticed meeting regarding the Board's appointments to the Commission.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board decided outside an open meeting not to reappoint a member to the Conservation Commission.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, we find that there was no improper deliberation and the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law.
